title: NBA Offseason Daily Digest
subtitle: July 30, 2026 – Trades, Free Agency, and Key Offseason Updates

items.headline: Kawhi Leonard's Raptors Return in Limbo Amid NBA Investigation
items.summary: The blockbuster trade that would send Kawhi Leonard back to the Toronto Raptors is currently on hold. The NBA is investigating the LA Clippers for alleged salary cap circumvention, and the probe could extend beyond the start of the 2026-27 season, delaying the multi-player deal.

items.headline: Sixers Clear Cap Space by Trading Johni Broome to Clippers
items.summary: The Philadelphia 76ers have traded forward Johni Broome and a 2027 second-round pick to the LA Clippers for cash considerations. This move was crucial for the Sixers to finalize the signing of free agent Kentavious Caldwell-Pope and remain under the luxury tax apron.

items.headline: Draymond Green Inks One-Year, $27.7M Extension with Warriors
items.summary: Veteran forward Draymond Green has reportedly re-signed with the Golden State Warriors on a one-year, $27.7 million contract extension. This secures his return to the team for the 2026-27 season after declining his player option.

items.headline: Cavaliers Linked to Nuggets' Peyton Watson in Trade Rumors
items.summary: The Cleveland Cavaliers are reportedly exploring a trade for Denver Nuggets forward Peyton Watson. Watson is seeking a contract near $25 million annually, a figure that could be challenging for the Nuggets due to existing commitments, potentially necessitating a multi-team deal.

items.headline: Deni Avdija's Role and Contract in Portland Under Scrutiny
items.summary: After an All-Star season, the impact of Damian Lillard's return and Ja Morant's addition on Deni Avdija's offensive role for the Portland Trail Blazers is a key topic of discussion. Additionally, Avdija's current team-friendly contract is reportedly becoming a complex issue for the Blazers' front office as they consider a future extension.

items.headline: Analyst Criticizes Warriors for Inactive Offseason
items.summary: A CBS Sports analyst has accused the Golden State Warriors of a 'basketball sin' for not adding any impact players this offseason. Despite Stephen Curry's continued high-level play at 38, the team has been notably quiet in free agency and trades, prompting concerns about their title contention.

items.headline: Slam Dunk Star Mac McClung Reportedly Eyeing Europe
items.summary: Two-time NBA Slam Dunk Contest champion Mac McClung is reportedly considering a move to Europe for the 2026-27 season. After prioritizing the NBA in previous years, McClung is now open to playing overseas.

items.headline: Golden State Warriors Crowned Las Vegas Summer League Champions
items.summary: The Golden State Warriors emerged victorious, claiming the 2026 Las Vegas NBA Summer League championship. Forward Yaxel Lendeborg was named the tournament's MVP for his standout performances.

items.headline: San Antonio Spurs Finish Las Vegas Summer League Strong
items.summary: The San Antonio Spurs concluded their 2026 NBA Summer League campaign with an impressive 4-1 record, highlighted by a final win against the Phoenix Suns in Las Vegas.
